data.name: Hexe Chambers
data.detailed_description:
Descend into dangerous chambers and save the kingdom!

The realm is in peril, and its salvation lies hidden deep inside ancient ruins. Armed with magical powers, you must explore perilous dungeons, fight monsters, and retrieve the sacred relic to break the kingdom’s curse.

Hexe Chambers is a straightforward, action-packed 2D top-down roguelike with a classic 8-bit art style. Pure arcade-style fun where strategy, spellcraft, and quick reflexes will lead you to victory!

Features:

  • Classic 8-Bit Pixel Art: Explore retro-inspired dungeons packed with unique chambers, traps, and monsters, all brought to life through clean 8-bit visuals.

  • Master Your Magic: Discover and upgrade a variety of spells as you progress. Select the best spells to suit your strategy and defeat the challenges ahead.

  • Loot & Upgrade: Uncover hidden chests, collect useful items, and make your character stronger to reach deeper into the dungeon.

Save the Kingdom

Reach the innermost chamber, recover the sacred relic, and restore peace to the kingdom!
